cause: Training/serving skew in the f1 transformation. The training pipeline stored f1 as log1p(raw) = ln(1 + raw), but the online serving path served the raw untransformed value (equivalently exp(f1_train) - 1). Joining the two feature groups on entity_id and comparing platform-side via Trino showed f2-f5 are bit-identical (mean abs diff = 0, corr = 1.0) while f1 differs systematically: serve_f1 = exp(train_f1) - 1 holds to within ~2e-5 (corr ~ 1.0). So the serving path is missing the log1p feature transformation that the training path applied.
